opus.problem: Matthew 4:18 says only that Jesus saw Simon and Andrew casting a net. The calling happens in 4:19. Widen the reference to Matthew 4:18-19 so the clue is true to its verse.

John 2:11 says Jesus performed His first sign at Cana in Galilee. It does not mention the wedding or the water turned to wine, which are in John 2:1-10. Widen the reference, for example to John 2:1-11.
John 7:52 does not mention Nicodemus or that he defended Jesus. That is in John 7:50-51. Widen the reference to John 7:50-52.
